artworks.title: Head of a Man Wearing a Plumed Turban
artworks.artist: Atelier of Gilles Demarteau the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (5th framing line): 23.4 x 16.7 cm (9 3/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
image: 18.6 x 13.3 cm (7 5/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person in profile, facing to the right. The individual is depicted in a thoughtful pose with their hand positioned under their chin. They have distinct facial features with a prominent nose and a contemplative expression. They are wearing a turban adorned with a large feather and a textured garment that appears to be a robe or cloak. The background is composed of cross-hatched shading in a soft gradient and is enclosed by a decorative border.

artworks.title: The Harbor of St. Malo at Low Tide
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling harbor scene with large fortress walls and various buildings dominating the composition. Sailing vessels are moored on the left, with their masts rising vertically. The artwork is created with fluid brushstrokes, giving a soft quality to the scene. The color palette is muted with beige, brown, and grey tones, with hints of blue. People are scattered along the pathway and near us, and the background features fortified city structures with tall, pointed roofs and arched entrances.

artworks.title: The School Walk
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with an old building on the left. The horizon is suggested by rooftops of buildings in the distance. Soft and textured brushstrokes create an impressionistic effect. Details are notably seen in the windows and roof. The color palette is warm with beige, light browns, red chimney bricks, and dark shadows. The sky is a pale blue. In front of the building, a group of figures, likely young girls with a woman, can be seen.

artworks.title: View of the Governor's House in St. Helena
artworks.medium: gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a hilly landscape with figures on horseback and on foot in the foreground. A building complex is located in the middle ground among rolling hills. The background consists of more hills creating a layered effect, leading to a high horizon and expansive sky. The painting features soft brushstrokes and a palette of sepia tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Evening on the Foss Dyke near Lincoln
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene from a slightly elevated angle. In the center, a large cart filled with hay is drawn by oxen. A man sits on top of the hay. To the left, two figures sit in a small boat on the water. The background features a wide sky with light hues and subtle brushstrokes. The landscape across the water is indicated with earthy tones and light strokes. The color palette consists of warm earth tones and calming pastels, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Meadow with Cattle near Glastonbury
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with a horizon near the middle featuring a tower and trees. Two cows are grazing in the foreground, with others further back. The scene is painted in watercolor with earthy tones, including soft greens, browns, and grays. The hills and sky blend in lighter, warmer shades, creating a serene and harmonious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Comfort the Afflicted
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures lying down on a fabric-covered surface. The figure on the left is reclined with arms folded beneath them, facing the figure on the right. The figure on the right is in a semi-reclining position, with their head supported by their hand. Both figures have long flowing hair and closed eyes, wearing loose garments. The background is a simple shaded area to enhance the contrast of the figures against the fabric.

artworks.title: St. James' Park with a View of Westminster Abbey
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is set low with large trees lining the edge of the water and a distant cityscape with identifiable buildings and towers. The brushwork is smooth and detailed, transitioning between elements realistically. The color palette consists of earthy tones, creating a natural and atmospheric effect. The water reflects the sky with gentle ripples, and figures are dispersed throughout the scene, adding scale to the landscape.

artworks.title: Travelers Resting by a Fallen Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view with a progression of elements from left to right. The horizon is above the center, showing rolling hills meeting a cloudy sky. The painting is textured with brushstrokes, featuring earthy and muted colors. Two figures are near a fallen tree, with a river to the right surrounded by trees and foliage. The sky has dynamic clouds.

artworks.title: Sailboats on Southampton River
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape painted from a distant viewpoint. The water extends towards the horizon with faint outlines of land masses and sailboats. The brushstrokes are delicate and fluid, conveying calmness and tranquility with soft blending. The color palette is muted with tones of beige, gray, and pale blue. The water close to us is depicted with wide strokes suggesting slight ripples. Sailboats and land lines add detail while maintaining a sense of stillness and openness.

artworks.title: Gleaners in the Wheat Field
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside scene with a sunlit field, distant trees and hills, a large tree on the right side, figures in the field, sheaves of wheat, and a pale blue sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Harvesters by Firelight
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and gouache on wove paper

artworks.title: The Naval College from the River at Greenwich
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene near the water's edge, capturing a river and grand architecture across it. The horizon shows buildings meeting the water, with their reflections visible on the surface. Delicate brushstrokes in a watercolor style enhance the serene quality. People are engaging in activities on or near the water, with boats nearby. In the distance, tall buildings with domed towers are visible, along with a sailing ship and smaller crafts. The color palette includes soft earth tones, pale blues, and hints of white. The sky has light touches of clouds, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: A Funeral Procession
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The horizon is high in the image, showing a townscape with a dome and spires against the sky. A procession is seen on a winding path below. Carriages pulled by horses, people in period attire, some mounted, move along. Onlookers observe on the right. Along the riverbank are large trees with sketched textures. The color palette is soft with muted tones. Buildings and path details are outlined with pen and ink.

artworks.title: The Peep Show
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a large box-like structure with a window and a flag. The scene depicts several individuals closely inspecting or engaging with what appears to be some form of a large play object or mock-up building, complete with a depiction of windows and a mounted blue flag on top. The box-like structure features artistic embellishments, giving it an ornate appearance. Around this object are nine figures, dressed in a variety of eighteenth-century styles, with one figure carrying a large bundle on their back. The setting is in a plain outdoor environment, with soft, muted colors predominating the drawing.

artworks.title: Market Day at Richmond in Yorkshire
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy market scene with people and animals in a town square. Buildings block the horizon, with an obelisk in the square's center and market stalls nearby. A clock tower with a visible clock face is on the left, and beyond are more buildings, including a gothic structure. The brushstrokes are gentle, creating a soft rendering. The color palette consists of muted tones such as pale browns, creams, and soft blue-grays, giving a calm atmosphere. The use of color and detailing enrich the depiction of the marketplace.

artworks.title: The Bridge at Bridgnorth in Shropshire
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a large hill in the background. A bridge arches over a river, with architectural structures visible. The painting features fine, detailed brushstrokes showing textures of stone, water, and foliage. The color palette includes muted earthy tones like browns, grays, and greens. People are seen doing laundry by the riverbank, with a sailboat nearby. In the distance, a hill rises into the sky with clouds.

artworks.title: A Packet Boat off Dover
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with touches of black chalk on gray wove paper, laid down
artworks.description: This painting shows a body of water with a steamboat in the distance emitting gray smoke. The steamboat is only partially visible behind the rough and frothy waves, painted in loose lines of white on the beige paper. The horizon is blurred, with the blue sky blending in with the pale waves. On the left, the silhouettes of buildings are faintly suggested in pale yellow.

artworks.title: A Yorkshire River
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper

artworks.title: Conway in North Wales
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated viewpoint, capturing a small town or village with a downward sloping street. The horizon is high in the composition, revealing a distant landscape beyond. The buildings on the left and right are quaint and rustic, some with thatched roofs, featuring a mix of timber and brickwork. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting architectural elements and textures. The color palette includes earth tones like browns, yellows, and grays, with touches of white and muted blues creating a warm atmosphere. A cobbled street leads towards two carts, figures, and an animal, inviting the viewer into the town scene.

artworks.title: Looking under the Bridge
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from under a large stone archway overlooking a calm waterway. The horizon is near the top of the image with buildings and a tower in the distance. A barge with a dog is moored near the archway, and a rowboat with two people is in the distance. The brushstrokes give the image a soft, slightly textured appearance, with attention to light and shadow on the arch and water. The color palette includes earthy browns and tans for the archway and barge, against soft blues and pinks in the sky. The background shows a hazy silhouette of buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Landing Place near Tintern Abbey
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a high horizon that includes green foliage, hills, and the sky. There is water in the foreground reflecting the surroundings, with a wooden jetty holding two boats, one with a person. Two figures and a horse are walking towards a white cottage with red chimneys and smoke rising. The painting uses smooth brushstrokes and a palette of earthy tones, greens, browns, and soft blues.

artworks.title: Venetian Party in a Chateau Garden
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown and gray wash, heightened with white on two sheets of paper joined vertically; incised for transfer; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, showcasing intricate architecture and a bustling urban scene. The artwork features fine brushwork with sepia tones, depicting groups of people engaging in activities within the city environment, surrounded by architectural landmarks and natural elements.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Road
artworks.medium: black, yellow, and red chalks with white heightening over gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the image where land and water meet against the backdrop of the sky. The brushstrokes create a sense of impressionism. The color palette includes browns, ochres, and muted greens, giving a tranquil feel. A path winds past trees and rocks in the foreground, with more trees in the distance. Trees of varying sizes are distributed across the view, creating depth and texture.
